title: Inside a Haunted House in Pennsylvania
shared_passage:
Watch a video about a haunted house in Pennsylvania. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

NARRATOR: Just a couple of minutes into the interview, our photojournalist, Nick, felt his wrist burning.

DEANNA: Are you okay? Did you get scratched?

NARRATOR: He was behind the camera. Simpson knew what had happened right away. Simpson says it's happened to her, her husband, and friends many times before.

DEANNA: That's unbelievable! God bless you. Do you know why? Because you are telling the story, because you are putting it out there. Because they don't want… I'm just telling you right now, that is their way of a warning.

NARRATOR: Both Simpson and her cat have been pushed down these stairs before. Simpson says it looks like someone she's seen before, and it's not a ghost; it's a demon. It's been seen in the basement.

DEANNA: When it came on me, I couldn't breathe, I couldn't scream, I couldn't move...

NARRATOR: Her grown daughters refuse to stay here. Meanwhile the family has invited mediums, researchers, and priests to visit the home. The results of one investigation will appear in the Travel Channel's show The Dead Files. Simpson says there is a history of grisly deaths in the house.

DEANNA: I have to prove to people our life, so in that way they'll understand.
